verdict.rationale: Batch submissions can register a notifications.webhook_url and secret, and Zoom sends a signed outbound POST (x-zm-signature, HMAC-SHA256, with documented verification and stale-timestamp rejection) when the job finishes. That is a real, registrable outbound HTTP callback a programmatic consumer can receive. However, it is scoped per batch job and to completion only, not a general event subscription. Missing for 10: webhooks for other event types or modes (live, fast, per-file progress), account-level subscription management, retry/delivery semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: A batch submission can register notifications.webhook_url and a secret to receive an outbound POST when the job finishes.
Zoom signs each request with an x-zm-signature HMAC-SHA256 value and timestamp
